62: They are his, etc. - The correct text is: 'They are his, because the owners have despaired.' For anything swept away by a river, like beams of wood and stones, the owners immediately become aware of it because it is something that creates a commotion (is widely known)."

This is the default case - But if it were another type of lost item, where we cannot assume that the owners were aware [of the loss], it would not belong to the finder. This presents a difficulty for Rava.
